testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a hidden Tools panel after switching ribbon tabs: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:695:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a hidden Tools panel after switching ribbon tabs ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Find panel is visible ✔ When the user hides Find from Show Panels on the Tools tab ✔ Then the Find panel disappears from the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user switches to 3D Model and returns to Tools ✔ Then the Find panel remains hidden ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the Tools tab ✔ Then Find is unchecked and Tutorials remains checked ✔ When the user selects Find ✔ Then the Find panel reappears before Team Web ✔ And Find and Tutorials are both visible
